::: research-callout1
We're a dedicated and diverse group working better understand insect responses to global change and advocate for their conservation. Interested in joining the group? See our available [opportunities](../opportunities.qmd) to learn more about joining the lab.

![](lab-photo.png){width="100%"}
:::
